messages:
maria: kicking off a quick dev/stg walkup for lynx-3b-int8. the goal is: sanity prompts, tokenization edgecases, kvcache behavior, and a perf baseline. will run a 5-min smoke and post findings.

deploy-bot: ephemeral stack created for lynx-3b-int8 on devstg-gpu-pool-2. endpoint: https://devstg-infer-2943210000.example.redwood, logs streaming.

ajay: running basic generation probe now. prompt set: short Q/A, bullet lists, code blocks. will post snippets if anything odd.

maria: quick checklist I ran thru: 1) tokenization roundtrip 2) short generation (<=64 tokens) 3) kv-cache reuse (2-step continuation) 4) perf perf counters (p50/p95) 5) top-k/top-p sanity 6) stop-token handling.

sophia: saw an early tokenization mismatch on a unicode emoji sequence. sample: "👍🏽" tokenized differently between hf-tokenizer and runtime. patch: normalize NFKC before tokenizing.

ajay: here's a failing trace for bullets:
```
Input: "- item one
- item two"
Output: "- item one- item two" (missing newline)
```
looks like newline getting collapsed in decode path for int8 kernel.

oliver: repro'd the bullet concat. small repro: 1) generate with max_new_tokens 20 2) use streaming True 3) stop token none. non-streaming seems fine. suspect stream buffer flush.

remy: perf numbers from the smoke (int8 profile, batch=1, seq=64): p50=38ms, p95=112ms, tokens/sec=850. KV-cache reuse case reduced p50 to 18ms on continuation.

maria: thanks. actionable items: @ajay look into stream flush + decode; @sophia add NFKC norm to preproc pipeline; @oliver try running with stream chunk 256 and see if newline issue persists; @remy attach perf trace to the ticket. I'll mark this as low-sev regression for int8 decoding but high priority for streaming path. :white_check_mark:

ajay: quick patch idea: ensure we flush pending decode buffer when we hit a newline char in the chunk. pushing a debug build to devstg now.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infer-runtime/debug-stream-flush -> devstg (build b2943210000).

maria: test note — also saw slightly higher logits variance vs fp16 on a couple prompt templates; we'll log evals and run a small nlp-eval set overnight to check quality regressions.

sophia: adding a short eval set (20 prompts) focusing on list formatting, code fences, and emoji handling. will run after the debug build lands and post diffs.

oliver: if debug build fixes it, we can backport to int8 profile. if not, fallback policy: prefer non-stream path for short-bullet responses until resolved.

maria: cool. leaving this thread open for results. ping me when you have the eval diffs or repro PR. :thumbsup:
